description: qa-browser hooks — SessionStart target reminder + PreToolUse production URL gate. Both hooks are advisory unless they detect a clear safety violation; the production gate is the only one that BLOCKS.

hooks.command: s="${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/hooks/session_start_target_check.py"; [ -f "$s" ] || exit 0; for c in python3 python py; do command -v $c >/dev/null 2>&1 || continue; [ $c = py ] && c='py -3'; $c "$s"; r=$?; [ $r -eq 49 ] || exit $r; done; exit 0

s="${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/hooks/pre_navigate_prod_gate.py"; [ -f "$s" ] || exit 0; for c in python3 python py; do command -v $c >/dev/null 2>&1 || continue; [ $c = py ] && c='py -3'; $c "$s"; r=$?; [ $r -eq 49 ] || exit $r; done; exit 0
